title: H3 All In One
description: Every MiniMax H3 job in one workflow: reference mode, first and last frame, keyframes built by Qwen Image Edit, a voice track, and an optional SeedVR2 upscale.
pick_when: Most video shots: a new scene from words or references, with sound and dialogue, 4-15 s; a shot that starts on a picture; lips that follow a voice track.

labels.100:value: Describe the action, camera and sound. Say "the main character", "the background" for the references.
labels.406:value: End keyframe prompt (edits the opening frame)

choices.label: Reference mode
choices.hint: a new scene built from your references

choices.label: First-frame mode
choices.hint: animates the FIRST FRAME exactly as it is (to the LAST FRAME if given); text to video with none

choices.label: Low
choices.hint: a fast turbo draft, about 30 s for 6 s at 480p

choices.label: Medium
choices.hint: the full model, 20 steps, about 1.5 min for 6 s at 480p

choices.label: High
choices.hint: the full model, 40 steps, about 3 min for 6 s at 480p and 10 min at 720p

choices.label: Keep my voice track
choices.hint: the lips follow the VOICE TRACK, which stays in the saved video

choices.label: Off
choices.hint: use the frames you give, if any

choices.label: Build the opening frame
choices.hint: Qwen Image Edit makes it from the subject and style images

choices.label: Build opening and end frames
choices.hint: and an end frame from a new camera angle

choices.label: On
choices.hint: SeedVR2, to the short edge below (slow)

hints: Reference mode builds a new scene from your references; first-frame mode keeps the first frame exactly and takes no other references: then describe only motion and camera.
Best results come from 5-6 s clips, one action each. Durations from 3 to 15 s work.

Quality: medium at 480p looks close to high at about half the time, for drafts and look tests; low can add people or effects nobody asked for. A final take where hands pass things or a ball is in play: high at 720p.
Prompt blocks, short: GOAL · SCENE · OPENING · SHOTS timed '[0-2s] size, lens, angle → one action → dialogue → move' · STYLE · END STATE · LOCKS. No shape or length words.
For speech write who says what, in quotes, in the beat it is said: the old man says: "Sign here." With a VOICE TRACK the lips follow your own audio. A silent clip says 'No dialogue. No music.'
Identity in words: age, build, the features that tell them apart; the same words every clip. No negative prompt: put short 'No ...' lines in LOCKS.
